  r=f.readline().strip();f.readline();f.readline()
  hs=ix.get(r,set())|ix.get(rc(r),set())
  if hs:
   obs[tuple(sorted(hs))]+=1;allzero+=1
print('exact any',allzero)
print('observed exact match sets')
for S,n in sorted(obs.items()):print(''.join(str(i+1) for i in S),n)
# predicted count classes for each source under forward/rev random, treating set exact across forward windows
pred={}
for ci,c in enumerate(keys):
 cnt=Counter()
 g=fa[c]
 for p in range(M):
  for q in (g[p:p+L],rc(g[p:p+L])):

   cnt[tuple(sorted(hs))]+=0.5
 pred[ci]=cnt
 print('source',ci+1,'classes nonzero',len(cnt),'total',sum(cnt.values()))
 print(' ',{''.join(str(i+1) for i in S):v for S,v in sorted(cnt.items())})

from collections import defaultdict,Counter
import gzip,math,time
import numpy as np
fa={}
for l in open('read.proportions.q1.fa'):
 l=l.strip()
 if l.startswith('>'):n=l[1:];fa[n]=''
 else:fa[n]+=l
keys=list(fa);L=36;M=len(fa[keys[0]])-L+1;comp=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN');rc=lambda s:s.translate(comp)[::-1]
reads=[]
with gzip.open('read.proportions.q1.fq.gz','rt') as f:
 while f.readline():s=f.readline().strip();f.readline();f.readline();reads.append(s)
for K in [8,6]:
 ix=defaultdict(list)
 for ci,c in enumerate(keys):
  g=fa[c]
  for p in range(len(g)-K+1):ix[g[p:p+K]].append((ci,p))
 t=time.time();D=Counter(); lows=Counter(); examples=[]
 # Store distances only for each read/chrom top <= maybe
 alld=[]
 for ri,r in enumerate(reads):
  out=[[] for _ in keys]
  for oi,q in enumerate((r,rc(r))):
   cand=[set() for _ in keys]
   for o in range(L-K+1):
    for ci,p in ix.get(q[o:o+K],[]):
     st=p-o
     if 0<=st<M:cand[ci].add(st)
   for ci,c in enumerate(keys):
    vals=[sum(a"'!=b for a,b in zip(q,fa[c][st:st+L])) for st in cand[ci]]
    out[ci].extend(vals)
  mins=[min(v) if v else 99 for v in out]
  D[min(mins)]+=1; lows[tuple(mins)]+=1
  alld.append(out)
 print('"'K',K,'time',time.time()-t,'best',D,'tuples top',lows.most_common(5))
 if K==6: candidates=alld
# EM likelihood with K6 candidate distances; use e q values
for e in [.001,.005,.008,.01,.02,.03]:
 # Compute per-read per chr log likelihood using all candidate windows, background omitted. log factor; orientation average constants irrelevant
 logs=[]
 for out in candidates:
  ll=[]
  for vals in out:
   if not vals: ll.append(-1e9);continue
   # duplicates? candidates set across orientations separately; a start could appear both orientations, correct sum
   terms=[(L-d)*math.log1p(-e)+d*math.log(e/3) for d in vals]
   m=max(terms); ll.append(m+math.log(sum(math.exp(x-m) for x in terms))-math.log(M))
  logs.append(ll)
 # EM start equal
 pi=np.ones(4)/4
 for it in range(100):
  post=[];new=np.zeros(4); total=0
  for ll in logs:
   z=np.array([math.log(pi[c])+ll[c] for c in range(4)])
   m=max(z);p=np.exp(z-m);p/=p.sum();new+=p
  new/=len(logs)
  if np.max(abs(new-pi))<1e-10:break
  pi=new
 print('e',e,'pi',pi,'it',it)
